name: annotate_region
description: Adds ONE labelled annotation note (3D pin, ribbon and notes-panel entry) and colors its residues in the note color. Use it whenever the request includes text for the residues ("annotate", "note", "label", "name", "comment"), including "highlight X in blue and label it": pass the color as color and do not also call highlight_region on those residues, which would list them twice in the viewer. The note covers every residue listed in residues (numbers and/or spans, possibly on different chains), or the start_auth_seq_id/end_auth_seq_id span, plus any whole chains listed in chains (use chains, e.g. ["B"], when the note is about an entire chain). When the same note applies to several residues, list them all in one call rather than adding one note per residue. If a note already covers exactly the same residues, that note is updated in place (its text replaced, and its color if color is given) instead of adding a second one; the result then has updated: true. Returns the id of the labelled entry in state.selections.

chains.description: Whole chains the note covers, as author chain ids (auth_asym_id), e.g. ["B"]. Use this instead of listing residues when the user means an entire chain: the viewer fills in the chain's residues from the loaded structure (until then the entry's residues for that chain are empty) and lists it as "Chain B". May be combined with residues on other chains.

color.description: Optional note color: a name (red, green, blue, yellow, orange, cyan, magenta) or #rgb / #rrggbb hex code. Colors the ribbon, 3D pin and notes-panel marker. A new note defaults to the color already on its first residue (the last color highlight covering it), else the default note color #ff4fa8 (hot pink); an updated note keeps its color. The resolved color is returned.

end_auth_seq_id.description: Author residue number ending a single contiguous span (default: start_auth_seq_id).

residues.description: Residues the note covers, as ONE entry: author residue numbers (auth_seq_id; e.g. [6, 10] is residues 6 and 10, not 6 to 10) and/or {"auth_asym_id", "start_auth_seq_id", "end_auth_seq_id"} objects for spans or residues on other chains (e.g. [{"auth_asym_id": "A", "start_auth_seq_id": 57, "end_auth_seq_id": 60}, {"auth_asym_id": "B", "start_auth_seq_id": 102}]). Entries of activeSelection ({"startResidue", "endResidue"}) can be passed as they are; use this form to give residue names (auth_comp_id), which the other forms cannot carry. Numbers and objects may be mixed. "end_auth_seq_id" defaults to "start_auth_seq_id"; a missing auth_asym_id defaults to the auth_asym_id argument. All ids are author ids, never label_*.

anyOf.description: An author residue number on the default chain.

auth_asym_id.description: Author chain id (default: the auth_asym_id argument).

endResidue.description: Last residue, on the same chain (default: startResidue).

auth_asym_id.description: Author chain id (default: the chain of startResidue).

auth_comp_id.description: Residue name, e.g. "GLY" (_atom_site.auth_comp_id), when the user gives it or you read it from the structure file. Stored as given (not checked against the structure).

auth_asym_id.description: Author chain id (default: the auth_asym_id argument).

auth_comp_id.description: Residue name, e.g. "GLY" (_atom_site.auth_comp_id), when the user gives it or you read it from the structure file. Stored as given (not checked against the structure).

start_auth_seq_id.description: Author residue number starting a single contiguous span (alternative to residues).

text.description: Annotation note text. Replaces the text of an existing note on the same residues.
